controls.name: C_S84_reproduces
controls.must_fire_because: the membership band this spike compares against is reproduced here with S84's own probe function on S84's own key files, before any new number is computed
controls.can_fail_because: S84.probe_set returns hash_bytes or proof_bytes differing from the committed verifycost.json
controls.null_must_contain: any drift in trie_witness, the key files or the counting hashlib would move these means

controls.name: C_every_proof_verified_true
controls.must_fire_because: A29: a probe that cannot show it reached its target has produced no evidence. A verifier returning False on line one hashes almost nothing and reports a small stable number
controls.can_fail_because: any row has verified_true < n_proofs, or zero proofs were built for a set
controls.null_must_contain: a proof that fails to verify, which raises SystemExit in the measurement loop

controls.name: C_every_path_position_forced
controls.must_fire_because: a sibling digest flipped at EACH path position independently must be rejected, or the verifier hashes bytes it does not actually check and the ratio prices nothing
controls.can_fail_because: any single-position corruption verifies TRUE, or no position had a sibling to flip
controls.null_must_contain: a verifier that checks only the last step would accept a corruption at position 0

controls.name: C_divergence_child_set_forced
controls.must_fire_because: absence is the claim "the next byte is not among this node's children", so a prover hiding the child that holds the key would prove a false absence. Both directions driven: a child removed, and the queried byte forged in
controls.can_fail_because: either tampered absence proof verifies TRUE, or neither edit was constructible on any probe
controls.null_must_contain: a verifier that folds the path and trusts the terminal descriptor accepts both edits

controls.name: C_answer_set_forced
controls.must_fire_because: completeness is the anti-omission claim, so an omitted answer key and an altered answer key must both be rejected -- this is the work that makes the verifier rebuild the subtrie
controls.can_fail_because: either tampered completeness proof verifies TRUE, or no proof carried two or more keys
controls.null_must_contain: a verifier that folds the path and takes the key list on trust accepts both edits

controls.name: C_null_is_flat
controls.must_fire_because: A20: "verifier work tracks proof size" is unfalsifiable without a verifier that genuinely does constant work. S84's flat_verify is that null and it must stay flat across both new kinds and all three sets
controls.can_fail_because: flat_verify's bytes hashed differ across rows, which would mean the null is reading the proof
controls.null_must_contain: the real verifier, whose bytes hashed differ by set and by kind

controls.name: C_worktree_agrees
controls.must_fire_because: the published numbers come from a byte-pin of the COMMITTED trie_witness.py (blob 57d1a481, HEAD 6d81a45) because the working-tree copy was uncommitted-modified while this ran. The same measurement against the working-tree copy must give identical rows, or the two verifiers are not the same verifier
controls.can_fail_because: any row or sweep point differs between the pinned and working-tree instruments, or the subprocess fails to run at all
controls.null_must_contain: the in-flight edit rewrites all three verify functions, so a behavioural change in any of them lands in these rows

falsifiers.name: F_S84_band_extends
falsifiers.can_fail_because: any of the six (kind x set) ratios falls OUTSIDE [1.06, 1.16]
falsifiers.null_must_contain: six ratios inside the band, which is what the membership rows already look like
falsifiers.refutes: this spike: if both new kinds sit inside the membership band, the verifier model extends by inspection and the cycle bought nothing
falsifiers.fires_when: any of the six (kind x set) ratios falls OUTSIDE [1.06, 1.16]

falsifier: absence and completeness verifier work inside S84's membership band [1.06, 1.16] on all three key sets, which would mean the verifier model extends by inspection
